main_text.p: גֶּלֶם m. Glomus, Massa rudis & informis.
גַּם Etiam, Quoque, Quinetiam: בְּשִׁגְגַם Eo quòd etiam, compositum ex ב & ש & ם.
גְּמָא Absorbsit, Exsorbsit, Exhausit: יִגְמָא אֶרֶץ Absorbet terram, Job.37.27. ubi Chaldeus, Fodit terram. Hiphil הִגְמִיאַנִי Sorbendum da mihi, Genes.24.17.
גַּמְדִּים Gammadaï, quasi Cubitales dicti, id est, Cubito potentes; Ezech.27.11.
גָּמַל Tribuit, Retribuit, Rependit: item Educavit, Ablactavit. Niphal, נִגְמַל Ablactari.
גְּמוּל Retributio: plur. גְּמוּלִים. Fæm. גְּמוּלָה, pluraliter גְּמוּלוֹת. תַּגְמוּל m. idem.
גָּמָל m: Camelus: plur: גְּמַלִּים Cameli.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel pointing and some Latin abbreviations are reproduced approximately; the Hebrew lines at the right edge and the marginal catchword "נמר" are partly faint. Small doubtful readings may need checking against the scan.
